text:
zoe: Heads-up 10am PT launch next Wed. Need three lightweight assets by Tue noon: 1) benchmark hero (1200x600) with two headline slots, 2) compact webinar signup modal (480x320) to drop into docs, 3) 20	30s vertical social GIF (1080x1350) for org channels. Keep everything on-brand and accessible.

marco: Can you confirm the two headlines and which is primary? Also need the Figma file.

zoe: Primary headline: 'Predictable LLM inference for production.' Secondary: 'Lower cost, consistent latency.' Figma: https://figma.com/file/launch-mini-suite-xyz

anya: Question: do we want a data viz on the hero (sparkline) or a qualitative icon set? Sparkline is more persuasive but must be clearly labelled.

josh: Sparkline please, but make it abstractnot raw numbers. Add a small caption: 'Representative benchmark; contact sales for details.' No chip names.

rachel: Legal note: confirmed avoid vendor/chip mentions and absolute claims ('X% faster') unless we have a vetted slide. Use 'lower' or 'reduced'. I'll sign off copy once drafts are in figma.

marco: I'll mock hero + modal today and drop initial frames by EOD. For the GIF do you want a subtle ease-in loop or a hard cut loop?

zoe: Ease-in loop. Keep it lightweight (under 2MB) for social. Use brand motion token (short spring).

brandbot: Brand token: CTA color = #FF3B30; secondary accent = #1B2330; type = Inter; weight CTA = 600. Contrast variant required.

designbot: Frame created: launch_mini_hero_v1 (1200x600), modal_signup_v1 (480x320), gif_vertical_v1 (1080x1350). Link: https://figma.com/frame/mini-frames-abc

marco: Uploaded hero v1 and modal v1. Hero uses sparkline with dotted baseline and caption, two headline text boxes so swapping is trivial. Modal has primary CTA and secondary tertiary link.

anya: Reviewing now. Quick accessibility callout: CTA button needs 4.5:1 contrast on hero asset. If background uses hero image overlay, use a 24% dark overlay.

josh: For analytics, give me two UTMs for the headline variants. Also make the modal CTA include a query param for webinar ID.

zoe: UTMs: variant A: utm_campaign=mini_launch_q2&utm_source=social&utm_variant=latency_first; variant B: utm_campaign=mini_launch_q2&utm_source=social&utm_variant=cost_first. Webinar ID param: ?webinar_id=2026-04-08

marco: GIF note: will export as mp4 + animated gif fallback. I'll optimize for web (avif preview if we can).

rachel: Confirming legal will review on Monday morning. Also request translations for JP and EN-GB? Marketing: yes for JP; EN-GB not required.

zoe: Ok JP copy needed for hero headline + modal labels. Can design keep layout flexible for slightly longer JP copy?

anya: Will plan for slightly taller headline area and scalable type.

marco: Plan: hero+modal drafts EOD today, gif rough Monday AM, copy pass Monday, final assets Tue noon PT. Ping here when you upload for review.

zoe: Thanks team 1. Tagging timeline in calendar: mock review Mon 11am PT, final handoff Tue 12pm PT.

josh: :thumbsup: Please add me to the figma comment thread for analytics notes.

marco: Done 1. Comment thread link: https://figma.com/comments/abc123

zoe: Great work1 Closing loop once final files are in the drive.
